dishes.name: Truffle Tagliatelle
dishes.description: Egg tagliatelle rolled this morning, folded through aged parmesan butter and finished at the table with shaved black truffle.
dishes.story: We roll the dough at seven, rest it under linen and cut it by hand. The sauce is only butter, parmesan and a ladle of the pasta water, so the truffle has the last word.
dishes.alt: A white bowl of ribbon tagliatelle, seen from above, covered with thin shavings of black truffle

dishes.name: Eggs Benedict
dishes.description: Two poached hen's eggs on a toasted English muffin with smoked ham and a slow-whisked lemon hollandaise.
dishes.story: The hollandaise is whisked over a bain-marie to order, never held. The eggs come from a farm forty minutes away and are poached for exactly three and a half minutes.
dishes.alt: Eggs Benedict on a plate seen from above: poached eggs on muffins coated in yellow hollandaise

dishes.name: Fish & Chips
dishes.description: Line-caught haddock in a crisp ale batter, triple-cooked chips, crushed minted peas and house tartare.
dishes.story: The batter is made with a local pale ale and fried in beef dripping. The chips are boiled, chilled and fried twice, so they stay fluffy inside and glassy outside.
dishes.alt: Battered fish and thick chips with peas on a plate, seen from above

dishes.name: Ruby Citrus Fizz
dishes.description: Blood orange and pink grapefruit, a dash of rosemary syrup, topped with sparkling water over hand-cut ice.
dishes.story: Pressed to order from blood oranges and pink grapefruit, sweetened with a syrup of rosemary from the garden and lengthened with cold sparkling water. Bright, bitter-edged and alcohol free.
dishes.alt: A glass of ruby-red citrus drink with ice and an orange slice
